verdict.rationale: Render's own site directly claims the story's capability: serving static assets faster with caching from its global CDN. Community comments praising Render's free static sites lend light support to the static-asset context, but the CDN claim itself is a single marketing line. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on edge locations and cache behavior (cache-control headers, invalidation/purge), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CDN performance.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve static assets faster using a global CDN with edge caching

citations.quote: Serve static assets faster with caching powered by Render’s global CDN.
In addition to great docker support and free static sites
